description: Work-item quality model (Lane 0.22, loop step 1). Before ranking, every open roadmap checkbox is classified actionable | done-statement | deferred | guidance | fragment. Only actionable is ranked, queued or offered for dispatch; every other line is kept, with the rule that excluded it, so the repository can show "Excluded (n)" with a reason per line. Classes are tested in the order listed and the first matching rule wins; a line no rule matches is actionable. A rule tests one field: text (the line without its tags), section (its heading) or tag (each [tag] on the line). A wrong call is a data change here with a modelVersion bump, never a code change (steering 2.6).
evidence: 1.0 measured 2026-11-11 over 65 local roadmaps (2,087 open lines): 1,884 actionable, 147 deferred, 25 guidance, 27 fragment, 4 done-statement before calibration; 1,913 actionable, 147 deferred, 22 guidance, 5 fragment after it. Calibrated against observed misfires: 'Guardrails' as a guidance section excluded a feature phase (powershell-resilience-pack); a trailing colon excluded 23 real items with nested detail (incendiary-web, 2026-06-13_Orchestration, MusicLibrary_v2), and verb-led three-word lead-ins (Add availability export:, Persist signature status:) are work too, so only a label of two words or fewer ending in a colon is a fragment; a mid-line check mark marked a recurring check done (AdministatorTools), so only a leading or trailing mark counts; a long imperative ending in 'implemented' read as done (BensClaudeTokenKillerv2), so that rule is capped at 90 characters; 'Code is implemented' under a Definition of Done (incendiary-web) is guidance, so guidance is tested before done-statement.

classes.description: Not a work item on its own: a single word, a short label introducing a nested list, or only a link or path.
classes.minWordsReason: a single word does not say what to do

rules.reason: a short label ending in a colon: it introduces the nested lines below it, which are the work
only a link, URL or code span: names a target but not the work

classes.description: Recorded on purpose as not-now work: a deferral tag, a deferral prefix, or a section reserved for later work.

rules.reason: the line itself says it is deferred
sits in a section reserved for later work

classes.description: A standing rule, principle or recurring checklist entry: true every time, never finished once.

rules.reason: sits in a section of standing rules
states a standing rule rather than a task

classes.description: Reads as a statement that the work is finished, left unticked.

rules.reason: opens by saying the work is done
opens or closes with a completion mark
a short line stating the work is complete

cooldown.description: The same item hash cannot be dispatched again inside this window unless the operator overrides.
